title: Henry Ford's First Car Company Folds, and He Builds a Racer
conflicts: Founding 5 August 1899 (Bryan/HFHA, automotivehistory.org) vs July 1899 (The Henry Ford records); no founding date given. Dissolution January 1901 (Bryan, The Henry Ford records) vs 'by November 1900' (automotivehistory.org) vs failed 'by summer 1901' (Henry Ford curators, 2021); January 1901 used. Vehicles 'no more than 20' / 'about 20' / Ford's 'nineteen or twenty'; 'no more than twenty' used. Henry Ford Company formed November 1901 (Bryan, automotivehistory.org) vs 1902 (Henry Ford lesson page); November used. Ford's 1922 memoir merges his first two companies and dates his resignation to March 1902; the story says that resignation was from the second company.
notes: Funding changed from mixed to venture (outside investors led by William H. Murphy; Ford had no personal funds). Causes of failure given only in Ford's own words, labelled as his account; historians' attributions to Ford's perfectionism or stockholders' haste are recorded in research_notes but not used in the story. Quote stance: challenges (luck in the Winton race vs Ford's tidy memoir).
